title: Breaking the sealed shelf in Wardmoor's record-house by main strength is tagged 'a hit costs standing with the Watch' — meaning outright success costs the same Watch reputation as failing the persuade attempt did, for a truth that mostly serves the Watch's own soldiers.
where: Wardmoor Record-House (Wynne), 'break the seal open, plainly'
